subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should OpenClaw accept `deferred` as a public cron/run status and expose the lifecycle classifier through the plugin SDK, or should this branch be narrowed to an internal yielded-parent repair?
rationale: The PR adds protocol, CLI/docs, UI, hook, and SDK surface area; code review can assess the implementation, but only maintainers can accept the long-term compatibility contract.

options.title: Require proof and contract signoff
options.body: Keep the public status/API shape only after maintainers accept it and the PR body adds the missing Discord and upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow the branch
options.body: Split the internal yielded-parent lifecycle repair from the public `deferred` and SDK contract additions if maintainers do not want the new surface yet.

options.title: Accept current risk
options.body: Merge on source review and existing cron proof while explicitly owning downstream client/plugin compatibility and unproven Discord-visible behavior.

recommendation.title: Require proof and contract signoff
recommendation.body: Keep the public status/API shape only after maintainers accept it and the PR body adds the missing Discord and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties jalehman to both subagent registry/session work and Discord/runtime-adjacent review, making them the best available routing owner for the cross-surface contract choice.
